name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 13 – Am 33
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13c. Stresses that cohesion policy must remain a core pillar of European integration and warns that rejecting these resources directly harms regions facing economic transition, job losses, and structural delays; calls for particular attention and dedicated, targeted measures to strengthen social cohesion, reduce economic, social and territorial disparities, and promote quality employment with fair wages, ensuring that tailored support is provided for vulnerable groups, workers facing economic transitions, and especially NEETs;
